register: natural decision-support and field-analyst language, varied syntax
policy: parser-blind post-freeze raw candidates; no qwen contact; frozen IR v2.1

questions.q: Which metro stations are recorded in Bengaluru, India?
questions.notes: The direct SELECT returns the requested point records without turning the request into a count.

questions.q: Show me the marketplaces mapped in Nairobi, Kenya.
questions.notes: The question asks for records, so an unaggregated SELECT answers the whole clause.

questions.q: How many coworking spaces are mapped in Nairobi, Kenya?
questions.notes: A spatial count over the coworking-space records matches the requested cardinality.

questions.q: What is the mapped count of craft workshops in Accra, Ghana?
questions.notes: The aggregation counts exactly the selected workshop records in the named city.

questions.q: Is at least one ATM mapped in Guadalajara, Mexico?
questions.notes: Presence, rather than count, directly answers whether any matching record exists.

questions.q: What is the mapped density of banks across Lyon, France?
questions.notes: Density is explicitly requested, so the selected bank records are spatially aggregated by density.

questions.q: What was France's informal employment rate in 2022?
questions.notes: This is a single-year ILOSTAT level, not a change or trend.

questions.q: What employment rate did Ile de France record in 2023?
questions.notes: The named NUTS-2 region, measure, and year are fully bound in one SELECT.

questions.q: What was the self-employment level in India in 2021?
questions.notes: The question requests one country indicator level at one year.

questions.q: What Gini coefficient was reported for Brazil in 2022?
questions.notes: The Gini measure, country, and year are literal and need no arithmetic.

questions.q: Did female average weekly hours worked in Germany trend upward or downward from 2019 through 2023?
questions.notes: The full bounded series feeds unary trend_direction; endpoint subtraction would answer a different question.

questions.q: Across 2022 to 2024, was the unemployment rate in Madrid region rising or falling?
questions.notes: The wording asks for direction over the bounded Eurostat series, not merely its endpoint difference.

questions.q: Does Jaipur, India have any mapped bus station?
questions.notes: The existential wording maps to presence and does not ask how many stations exist.

questions.q: How densely are cafes mapped across Marrakech, Morocco?
questions.notes: The adverb densely calls for spatial density rather than a raw record count.

questions.q: Give the number of mapped pharmacies in Valencia, Spain.
questions.notes: The requested number is the count of selected pharmacy records.

questions.q: Return Bengaluru's mapped marketplaces annotated with distance to the nearest metro station.
questions.notes: ANNOTATE preserves each marketplace record while adding the requested nearest-distance layer.

questions.q: Which coworking spaces in Nairobi are within 1 kilometre of a bank?
questions.notes: The relation filters coworking-space records against bank records at the stated threshold.

questions.q: Which banks in Bengaluru lie more than 2 kilometres from every metro station?
questions.notes: Beyond is the complement relation required by more-than-distance wording.

questions.q: How many Bengaluru marketplaces are within 500 metres of a metro station?
questions.notes: Five hundred metres is 0.5 km, and count applies after the spatial relation.

questions.q: Is any craft workshop in Accra within 1 kilometre of a bank?
questions.notes: The relation is evaluated first and presence answers the existential request.

questions.q: What is the density of Porto coworking spaces beyond three quarters of a kilometre from a bank?
questions.notes: The worded fraction becomes 0.75 km and density is computed over the beyond-related set.

questions.q: How far are Bengaluru's mapped marketplaces from its metro stations?
questions.notes: The clause asks for a distance relation between two record sets, not a comparison of their counts.

questions.q: Which Bengaluru coworking spaces are within 600 metres of a metro station but beyond 250 metres from a bank?
questions.notes: Chained RELATE nodes enforce both anchors on one returned coworking-space set.

questions.q: Which Accra craft workshops are more than half a kilometre from a bank and within 1.5 kilometres of a bus station?
questions.notes: The nested tree retains the beyond and within constraints with their distinct thresholds.

questions.q: How many ATMs in Mexico City are no farther than 350 metres from a marketplace?
questions.notes: No farther than 350 metres maps to within 0.35 km before counting.

questions.q: Is there a Cape Town bank beyond 1.25 kilometres from every bus station?
questions.notes: The existential answer is presence over banks satisfying the explicit beyond relation.

questions.q: How dense are Nairobi marketplaces located within three quarters of a kilometre of a bank?
questions.notes: The related marketplace set is spatially aggregated by density, with the fraction normalized to kilometres.

questions.q: Which Accra craft workshops co-occur with a marketplace?
questions.notes: Co-occurrence is a relation over the two record sets and returns the left-hand workshop records.

questions.q: How many Accra craft workshops co-occur with a marketplace?
questions.notes: Unlike the preceding relation-return form, this clause explicitly counts the co-occurring set.

questions.q: List Berlin's mapped banks with each one's distance to the nearest metro station.
questions.notes: The nearest-distance layer is attached to each selected bank record.

questions.q: Return Lyon ATMs within 400 metres of a bank, annotated by distance to the nearest metro station.
questions.output_form: related ATM records with nearest-distance annotation
questions.notes: One record result is first constrained by proximity and then annotated with the requested nearest distance.

questions.q: Which cafes are near coworking spaces in Berlin?
questions.notes: Near supplies the within relation but no numeric threshold, so none is invented.

questions.q: Which Porto marketplaces are farther than one and a half kilometres from a bank?
questions.notes: The worded decimal is preserved as a 1.5 km beyond threshold.

questions.q: How many Berlin coworking spaces are within 800 metres of a metro station yet beyond 300 metres from a bank?
questions.notes: The count applies only after both spatial constraints have been chained.

questions.q: What informal employment rate did France report for 2021?
questions.notes: This is a fully bound ILOSTAT point level.

questions.q: How many hours per week did employed women in Germany average in 2020?
questions.notes: The exact curated female-hours measure encodes the requested population and unit.

questions.q: What was Spain's labour underutilization rate in 2023?
questions.notes: The clause asks only for the named country's 2023 level.

questions.q: What was Kenya's average weekly hours worked in 2021?
questions.notes: The census verifies this country, measure, and year as an ILOSTAT level.

questions.q: What was the female employment rate in Berlin, Germany, in 2024?
questions.notes: The exact Eurostat measure is already subgroup-specific, so no unsupported filter is introduced.

questions.q: How many thousand employed persons were recorded in Catalonia in 2022?
questions.notes: The curated Eurostat entity carries the thousand-person unit and needs no count aggregation.

questions.q: What employment rate did Lombardy, Italy record in 2023?
questions.notes: A direct level SELECT distinguishes the statistic from a spatial point-record aggregate.

questions.q: What was the employment rate in Warsaw capital region, Poland, in 2024?
questions.notes: The curated NUTS-2 region and year are explicitly bound.

questions.q: What Gini coefficient did India have in 2022?
questions.notes: This is a Gini level at the verified country grain.

questions.q: What was Ghana's youth unemployment level in 2021?
questions.notes: The World Bank country-series level is selected directly for the stated year.

questions.q: Over 2019 through 2023, which way did France's informal employment rate trend?
questions.notes: All observations in the bounded window inform unary trend direction.

questions.q: Was self employment in Kenya generally rising or falling between 2010 and 2022?
questions.notes: Generally rising or falling denotes a trend over the World Bank window, not endpoint arithmetic.

questions.q: From 2014 through 2024, did Brazil's Gini coefficient trend up or down?
questions.notes: The bounded Gini series is the sole operand of trend_direction.

questions.q: Across 2022–2024, did Ile de France's employment rate move on an upward or downward trend?
questions.notes: The complete three-year bounded series supports the requested direction.

questions.q: By how many percentage points did Spain's labour underutilization rate change from 2019 to 2023?
questions.notes: COMPARE applies the frozen later-minus-earlier rule to the two requested endpoints.

questions.q: What was the change in Catalonia's employed-person level between 2022 and 2024?
questions.notes: The two scalar levels are compared as later minus earlier, preserving the thousand-person unit.

questions.q: How much did India's labor force participation change from 2010 to 2020?
questions.notes: The endpoint-difference tree answers how much the country indicator changed.

questions.q: What was Kenya's Gini change from 2015 to 2022?
questions.notes: The later-minus-earlier comparison represents endpoint change rather than a fitted trend.

questions.q: What was the ratio of Germany's 2023 female average weekly hours worked to its 2019 level?
questions.notes: Both operands have hours-per-week units and the requested temporal ratio is later over earlier.

questions.q: How did Berlin's 2024 female employment rate compare as a ratio to its 2022 rate?
questions.notes: The same Eurostat percent measure appears on both sides of a later-over-earlier ratio.

questions.q: What is France's 2022 youth unemployment divided by its 2012 level?
questions.notes: Divided by fixes a same-measure ratio, with the later year in the numerator.

questions.q: What is the ratio of Brazil's 2024 Gini coefficient to its 2014 coefficient?
questions.notes: The ratio compares the same dimensionless Gini measure at two endpoints.

questions.q: For 2022, what is France's informal employment rate minus Spain's?
questions.notes: Equal years preserve the explicitly requested France-minus-Spain place orientation.

questions.q: In 2023, subtract Lombardy's employment rate from Ile de France's.
questions.notes: The first named region remains left because both operands share the same year.

questions.q: In 2023, what is France's ILOSTAT informal employment rate minus Ile de France's Eurostat employment rate?
questions.notes: Both census measures are percentages, and the explicit source-aware subtraction preserves left/right order.

questions.q: For 2023, what is Germany's ILOSTAT labour underutilization rate divided by Berlin's Eurostat unemployment rate?
questions.notes: The census gives both operands in percent, and divided by fixes Germany as the numerator.

questions.q: Which had the highest self-employment level in 2021: India, Kenya, or Ghana?
questions.notes: All three named candidates are closed into a descending scalar-level rank with k=1.

questions.q: Among France, Germany, and Kenya, which recorded the lowest average weekly hours worked in 2021?
questions.notes: The exact candidate set is ranked ascending and k=1 returns only the minimum.

questions.q: Which two had the highest 2024 employment rates: Ile de France, Berlin, Lombardy, or Warsaw capital region?
questions.notes: All four candidates appear once and descending k=2 matches the requested top two.

questions.q: Name the three lowest 2023 unemployment rates among Madrid region, Catalonia, Berlin, Lombardy, and Ile de France.
questions.notes: Ascending order and k=3 implement the bottom-three request over exactly five named regions.

questions.q: Rank Brazil, India, and Kenya by their 2022 Gini coefficients, highest to lowest.
questions.notes: No k is supplied because the clause explicitly requests a full ordering of all three countries.

questions.q: Order France, Spain, and Germany from lowest to highest informal employment rate in 2022.
questions.notes: The full ascending rank contains exactly the three countries named in the clause.

questions.q: Which of France, Germany, and Spain had the largest increase in youth unemployment from 2012 to 2022?
questions.notes: Each item is its country's later-minus-earlier change, then descending k=1 selects the largest.

questions.q: Rank Ile de France, Berlin, and Lombardy by their 2022-to-2024 employment-rate change, smallest to largest.
questions.notes: The rank scalarizes three endpoint differences and omits k to return every named region.

questions.q: Which two cities have the most marketplaces within 1 kilometre of a bank: Nairobi, Accra, or Bengaluru?
questions.output_form: top two cities by related count
questions.notes: Each city contributes one related-set count, and descending k=2 closes the exact three-city contest.

questions.q: Which has the fewest coworking spaces beyond half a kilometre from a metro station: Berlin, Madrid, or Paris?
questions.notes: Ascending k=1 ranks three like-for-like beyond-related counts and returns the fewest.

questions.q: Rank Lyon, Porto, and Valencia by mapped bank density, highest to lowest.
questions.notes: Each item is a bank-density field scalarized for a full descending ranking.

questions.q: Which two had the lowest labor force participation in 2020: India, Kenya, Ghana, or France?
questions.notes: The four-country candidate set is exact, with ascending k=2 for the two lowest levels.

questions.q: Rank France, Germany, and Spain by the ratio of their 2023 labour underutilization rate to their 2019 rate, highest to lowest.
questions.notes: Each item is a same-unit later-over-earlier ratio, and the full rank includes all named countries.

questions.q: Which had the highest unemployment rate in 2024: Madrid region, Catalonia, or Berlin?
questions.notes: Descending k=1 answers the winner question over exactly three Eurostat regions.

questions.q: Rank Accra, Berlin, and Bengaluru by craft workshops within 1 kilometre of a bus station but beyond 300 metres from a bank, most to fewest.
questions.notes: Each candidate count enforces both anchors, and omitting k returns the requested full order.

questions.q: Rank these 2022 percentages from highest to lowest: France's informal employment rate, Berlin's unemployment rate, and Kenya's youth unemployment.
questions.notes: The three census-backed operands share percent units and the question explicitly requests their full cross-source order.

questions.q: Using marketplace records from Accra, estimate marketplace coverage in Kumasi with the envelope method.
questions.output_form: modelled marketplace field or gate DataRequest
questions.notes: Accra supplies Records, Kumasi is the target REGION, and the explicitly named method is preserved.

questions.q: Interpolate a coworking-space field for Mombasa from Nairobi's coworking-space records.
questions.output_form: modelled coworking-space field or gate DataRequest
questions.notes: The source SELECT is Records and the separate Mombasa REGION is the interpolation target.

questions.q: Use Berlin bank records with the feature method to estimate a bank field for Potsdam.
questions.output_form: modelled bank field or gate DataRequest
questions.notes: The feature method receives bank Records and a distinct target REGION exactly as requested.

questions.q: Using Accra marketplaces within 1 kilometre of a bank, estimate marketplace coverage in Kumasi by envelope.
questions.output_form: modelled field from a related-record source or gate DataRequest
questions.notes: RELATE still yields Records, making the constrained source type-valid for the envelope estimate.

questions.q: Estimate ATM coverage in Ghent from Brussels ATM records using an envelope.
questions.output_form: modelled ATM field or gate DataRequest
questions.notes: The named source and target roles are distinct and the gate may honestly return a DataRequest.

questions.q: Using Lyon's bank records, estimate bank coverage in that other city with the envelope method.
questions.notes: Only the deictic target role is unresolved; source entity, source place, and method remain bound.

questions.q: Using ATM records from the reference city, estimate ATM coverage in Porto by interpolation.
questions.notes: Only the anaphoric source REGION is holed; Porto, ATM, and interpolate are explicit.

questions.q: Using records for a suitable livelihood facility in Nairobi, estimate its field for Mombasa with the feature method.
questions.output_form: clarification for the source facility type
questions.notes: The facility type alone is genuinely underspecified while both regional roles and the method are bound.

questions.q: How many marketplaces are there?
questions.notes: Marketplace and count are explicit; only the absent place is holed.

questions.q: Did its employment rate trend upward or downward from 2022 through 2024?
questions.notes: The anaphor leaves only the region unresolved; measure, window, and trend operation are stated.

questions.q: How many of those are in Nairobi?
questions.notes: Nairobi and count are bound, while the isolated anaphor leaves only the entity role unresolved.

questions.q: Are any banks within 500 metres of them in Accra?
questions.output_form: clarification for the relation anchor entity
questions.notes: Bank, Accra, threshold, relation, and presence are bound; only the pronoun's anchor entity is unresolved.

questions.q: Which livelihood facilities are within 700 metres of a bank in Nairobi?
questions.notes: The broad facility phrase does not identify a supported subtype, so only that role is holed.

questions.q: Do traders in Nairobi prefer marketplaces near banks?
questions.output_form: request for an observable preference proxy
questions.notes: Mapped facilities cannot establish human preference, so the genuinely missing observable proxy is explicit.

questions.q: Are Berlin freelancers intending to use coworking spaces next year?
questions.output_form: request for an observable intent proxy
questions.notes: Coworking-space presence does not prove future intent; an observable proxy must be supplied.

questions.q: Why do craft workers in Accra choose workshops near bus stations?
questions.output_form: request for an observable motive proxy
questions.notes: Spatial co-location cannot establish motive, so the tree honestly requests a measurable proxy.

questions.q: What was median monthly earnings in Patagonia in 2021?
questions.output_form: source-gap DataRequest for a regional earnings statistic
questions.notes: Every role is literal and bound; the unsupported measure and non-curated region create a source gap, not ambiguity.

questions.q: How many fisheries cooperatives are registered in Suva, Fiji?
questions.notes: The entity and place are fully specified, but no verified connector family supplies these records.

questions.q: What was Ontario's Gini coefficient in 2020?
questions.notes: The request is fully bound, but the verified Gini source is country-grain rather than this non-curated region.

questions.q: What employment rate did Bavaria record in 2023?
questions.output_form: source-gap DataRequest for a non-curated regional statistic
questions.notes: The measure, region, and year are bound, but Bavaria is outside the census's curated Eurostat NUTS-2 regions.
